_README: Every user-facing string in RinSetu. src/core/ emits keys from this file and never an English sentence (CLAUDE.md hard rule 3). Placeholders are {braced} and substituted by t() in src/messages/index.ts. Phase 7 replaces that helper with next-intl and adds hi.json, mr.json and ta.json alongside this file — the keys do not change.

health.heading: Partner throughput
health.score_help: A transparent weighted score, not a prediction. Each factor's contribution is shown so you can see exactly why one partner ranks above another.
health.simulated_detail: These throughput figures are simulated for development. They are not a real partner's performance and must not be read as one.

fund_availability.rationale: Weighted highest because a partner with no funds left cannot sanction your loan at any speed.

npa.rationale: A high non-performing share tends to make a partner cautious, which slows new sanctions.

overdue.rationale: Overdue recovery competes for the same staff time as new applications.

speed.rationale: Average days from application to sanction — the delay the problem statement is about.

capacity.multiplier_note: A closed partner scores zero rather than being hidden, so you can see it exists and why it is unavailable.

recommendation.heading: Recommended

policy.largest_share_then_lowest_rate: Chosen because it funds the largest share of your project, and where two schemes fund the same share, at the lower interest rate. This is our ranking rule, not a scheme rule.

ui.tagline: Concessional credit, worked out in the open

meta.title: RinSetu — concessional credit, worked out in the open
meta.description: Matches an applicant to concessional credit schemes, computes the loan and instalment under that scheme's own rules, and routes to the nearest channel partner that can actually take the file.

footer.build: A Smart India Hackathon 2026 prototype for problem statement SIH26092. Eligibility, loan and instalment figures are computed by deterministic code, not by a language model.
footer.not_an_offer: Scheme parameters in this build are placeholders and a demo overlay. Nothing on these screens is an offer of credit.

home.lede: One short form. Every scheme checked, the loan worked out in full, and the branch that can take your file.
home.step_1_body: Twelve questions, all skippable. Anything left blank is recorded as not known, never as zero.
home.step_2_body: Each condition gets its own verdict — met, not met, or undecidable — with the figure it was checked against.
home.step_3_title: The loan is computed, not estimated
home.step_3_body: Subsidy, margin money, caps, moratorium treatment and the full month-by-month schedule, from the scheme's own parameters.
home.step_4_title: You are routed to a branch
home.step_4_body: Partners that cannot handle the scheme or the loan size are filtered out first, then the rest are ordered by distance and by throughput.
home.honesty_heading: What this build will and will not do
home.will_1: It shows every scheme you fail, and the smallest change that would flip each failure.
home.will_2: It separates "you do not qualify" from "we could not tell", and never reports the second as the first.
home.will_3: It stamps every figure with where the figure came from.
home.wont_1: It will not quote a rate, ceiling or subsidy as fact until that figure has been transcribed from the published guideline. Until then the calculator runs on an openly-labelled demo overlay.
home.wont_2: It will not use a language model to decide eligibility or produce any number.

result.heading: Result
result.empty_detail: This page needs answers in the link. Start a new application, or open one of the test cases.
result.invalid_heading: That link could not be read
result.invalid_detail: One of the values in the address is outside what the form can produce. Start again rather than trusting a half-read answer.

personas.heading: Test cases
personas.lede: Each case is a committed fixture that pins one edge of the engine — an income a rupee over the cap, an unknown age, a loan larger than any partner writes. Open one to see exactly what the engine does with it.
